# KiCad library attribution

The project-local standard footprint and 3D model subsets in both `rev_a/libraries/` and the frozen `rev_a_6v_archive/libraries/` were copied from the official KiCad 10.0.6 distribution. They are credited to the KiCad library community and to authors identified in individual files. Original STEP copyright/license comments remain intact. The archived files remain unchanged; these accompanying notices cover that subset as well.

- [Footprint/library license](KiCad_LIBRARY_LICENSE.md), copied from the [official footprint repository](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-footprints/-/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
- [3D library license](KiCad_MODELS_LICENSE.md), copied from the [official 3D repository](https://gitlab.com/kicad/libraries/kicad-packages3D/-/blob/master/LICENSE.md).
- [KiCad's library-license explanation](https://www.kicad.org/libraries/license/).

Notices retrieved 2026-09-28. Standard local footprint copies include project-specific model-path rebinding; selected capacitor and switch bindings use separately generated nominal models. Custom `AI_Robot` package footprints and nominal meshes are described in each revision's footprint/model review and must not be represented as manufacturer-certified CAD. These notices do not assign a new license to the user's robot software or circuit design.
